name: The Ogres of Feralas
summary: At Camp Mojache, Rok Orhan calls for the Gordunni to be driven back. Their outpost lies up the river to the north.

sections.title: The Mark of the Gordunni
sections.body: Rok Orhan says the Gordunni ogres scar the land around Camp Mojache. Drive the tribe back before it reaches deeper into Feralas. Follow the river north to find their outpost. There, slay ten Gordunni Ogres, ten Gordunni Ogre-Magi and five Gordunni Brutes to show the tribe they are unwelcome.

faq.q: Who wants the Gordunni ogres driven back?
faq.answer: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache wants the Gordunni ogres driven back.

faq.q: Why does Rok Orhan want the Gordunni pushed back?
faq.answer: Rok Orhan says the Gordunni scar the land and must be stopped before they spread farther into Feralas.
Follow the river north to find the Gordunni outpost.
Slay ten Gordunni Ogres, ten Gordunni Ogre-Magi and five Gordunni Brutes.
The chain continues with The Ogres of Feralas two.
